meta.title: Characters | Nuppu
meta.description: Meet Nuppu, Muru, Hippu, and Lumo, lovable characters that help children recognize and manage emotions.

characters.heroSubtitle: Four lovable characters, each with their own personality, ready to guide your child through the beautiful journey of understanding and managing emotions.

nuppu.description: Nuppu is a gentle bunny who walks alongside the child through all emotions. Nuppu can name feelings and notices even the smallest details. Nuppu never says a feeling is wrong, but helps the child understand where it came from and where it can go.

muru.description: Muru is calm, gentle, and always ready to listen. They remind children that all emotions are allowed. With Muru, it's okay to be quiet, sad, or tired—just the way you are.

hippu.description: Hippu is a curious and independent cat who enjoys trying new things. Hippu often wonders: What do I want? How do I feel? Do I dare to say it out loud? Hippu teaches that personal boundaries are important.

lumo.description: Lumo is a clever and perceptive fox who helps examine situations from many angles. Lumo doesn't give ready-made answers but asks good questions. From Lumo, children learn that mistakes are part of learning—and that even difficult emotions can teach us.

bottom.title: Every Child Deserves a Friend Who Understands
bottom.subtitle: Our characters adapt to your child's emotional needs, providing personalized support through stories, exercises, and gentle guidance.

emotionalSupport.title: Support for a child's big emotions

meta.title: About | Nuppu
meta.description: Learn the mission, values, and evidence-informed approach behind Nuppu's child-first emotional learning platform.

about.heroSubtitle: Building a safer, healthier digital world where children can learn to understand and manage their emotions with confidence.

background.title: Background Idea
background.p1: Nuppu Digital responds to the growing need to support children's emotional skills at an early stage of development. In everyday life, children encounter emotions and stress that they are not yet able to put into words. Nuppu offers children a safe, gentle, and encouraging way to explore their own emotions before challenges begin to pile up.
background.p2: The foundation of the brand is the idea that understanding emotions is a skill that can be practiced with the same lightness as learning to read or count.

founder.title: Founder Story
founder.name: Emmi Yli-Sissala, Nurse
founder.p1: I am a nurse and mother of two toddlers. Both in my work and in my daily life, I have seen how important supporting children's emotional skills is for well-being and how parents often lack concrete tools in challenging emotional situations.
founder.p2: As a nurse, I believe in prevention. As a mother, I know that emotional skills training begins in early childhood. Based on these insights, Nuppu Digital was born – a gentle and child-oriented emotional skills ecosystem that supports both children and parents in the midst of everyday life.
founder.p3: Nuppu is not just an app. It is the answer to the real need to provide emotional skills in a timely, safe and equal manner to every child.

cofounder.title: Co-Founder Story
cofounder.name: Laura Turunen, Pedagogical Lead
cofounder.p1: I am a social worker (YAMK), a mother of two young children, and a professional working with children and families.
cofounder.p2: My career has been in early childhood education, child welfare, the school world, and immigrant services, which has given me a broad perspective on children's development and well-being.
cofounder.p3: I started building Nuppu because I believe that emotional skills can be strengthened in everyday life with small, concrete actions.
cofounder.p4: Nuppu offers children and educators easy-to-use tools that support positive growth, learning, and interaction.

promise.title: Brand Promise
promise.intro: At the core of Nuppu Digital's brand is the idea that every emotion is allowed and every child deserves to be treated with respect.
promise.p1: Nuppu does not focus on achievements or perfection, but rather helps children understand themselves, build their emotional skills and grow into their own unique self. At the same time, it offers parents and educators gentle, concrete tools for everyday emotional moments.
promise.p2: We believe that emotional education should be safe, easily accessible and part of everyday life. Nuppu builds trust in both children and adults by being warm, child-oriented and genuinely human.
promise.p3: Understanding emotions is a skill that everyone can learn.

values.title: Our Core Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide everything we do at Nuppu

childFirst.title: Child-First Approach
childFirst.description: Every decision we make prioritizes children's emotional wellbeing and healthy development.

safety.title: Safety & Privacy
safety.description: GDPR compliant, ad-free, and built with the highest standards of data protection.

evidence.title: Evidence-Based
evidence.description: Grounded in psychological research and developmental science for proven results.

family.title: Family Connection
family.description: Strengthening bonds between parents and children through shared experiences.

brain.title: The Brain Behind Nuppu
brain.intro: Nuppu isn't just another children's app—it's built on a foundation of psychological research and child development science.

f1.title: Predefined Story Structures
f1.description: Each story follows carefully crafted emotional arcs that guide children through recognizing, understanding, and managing their feelings.

f2.title: Age-Appropriate Boundaries
f2.description: Content is carefully tailored to different developmental stages, ensuring children receive appropriate emotional education.

f3.title: Positive Reinforcement
f3.description: Built on principles of encouragement and growth mindset, helping children build confidence in their emotional abilities.

f4.title: Mindfulness Integration
f4.description: Incorporates breathing exercises, grounding techniques, and awareness practices suitable for young minds.

visual.title: Visual Promise
visual.p1: Nuppu's visual world is designed to calm rather than overstimulate. Soft, rounded characters are empathetic and approachable, serving as mirrors of emotional states for the child.
visual.p2: Pastel-toned, slightly hand-drawn illustrations bring a sense of humanity and distinguish Nuppu from hard, technical learning solutions. The visual identity supports focus, a sense of safety, and long-term use, which is also essential for product engagement.

ux.title: User Experience for Children
ux.p1: The child's user experience is built around emotions. Navigation does not ask what the child can do, but how they feel. The interface is clear and intuitive, allowing the child to use it independently without constant guidance.
ux.p2: Small, positive feedback reinforces a sense of success and supports intrinsic motivation. The experience is designed so that the child wants to return to Nuppu again and again.

value.title: Value for Parents & Teachers
value.p1: For adults, Nuppu offers support, tools, peace of mind, and clarity. Parents and teachers receive a calm overview of the child's progress without constant notification overload or demanding usage.
value.p2: Nuppu does not add to everyday burden but supports what adults are already doing for the child's well-being. This makes the product easy to adopt and a natural part of family and school life.

tech.title: Technology Supporting Development
tech.p1: Nuppu Digital uses technology thoughtfully and with respect for the child's development. Technology acts as an invisible enabler, not the main focus.
tech.p2: Animations are slow and calming, and interactions are predictable and safe. This approach supports long-term use and distinguishes Nuppu from fast-paced, addictive children's apps.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | Nuppu
meta.description: Read how Nuppu protects personal data and supports child-safe, GDPR-aligned experiences.

collect.title: What We Collect
collect.text: We collect only the information required to respond to your contact request (name, email, role, and message content) and, if you book a paid emotional support consultation, the information required to process and reconcile that payment (your name, email, the amount paid, and a payment reference and status from our payment provider, Paytrail).

why.title: Why We Collect It
why.text: We use your data to respond to inquiries, improve our service, maintain security of the platform, and - for consultation bookings - to fulfil the paid service you requested and to meet our bookkeeping obligations under Finnish law.

payments.title: Payments
payments.p1: When you book and pay for the 45-minute emotional support consultation, payment is processed by **Paytrail Oyj**, a licensed Finnish payment institution supervised by the Finnish Financial Supervisory Authority (FIN-FSA). You enter your card, bank, or mobile payment details directly on Paytrail's secure checkout page - **we never see or store your card number, bank credentials, or CVV**.
payments.p2: We store only what's needed to reconcile your payment and deliver the consultation: your name, email, the amount paid, a Paytrail transaction reference, and the payment status.
payments.p3: **Legal basis:** processing your payment data is necessary to fulfil the contract for the consultation you booked (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR), and to comply with our statutory bookkeeping obligations under the Finnish Accounting Act (Kirjanpitolaki) (Article 6(1)(c) GDPR).
payments.p4: **Retention:** Finnish accounting law requires us to keep payment records for 6 years from the end of the fiscal year in which the payment was made. After that period, we anonymise the record (removing your name and email) rather than deleting it outright, so that our accounting trail stays intact without keeping your personal data any longer than required.

protection.title: Data Protection
protection.text: Nuppu applies technical and organizational measures to protect personal data and to keep access limited to authorized team members. Our database (MongoDB Atlas) and payment provider (Paytrail) both store data within the EU and encrypt data at rest and in transit.
protection.seeAfter: for information about cookies and similar technologies.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: You can request access, correction, deletion (anonymisation, where records must be retained for bookkeeping purposes), or export of your personal data by contacting us at nuppudigital@gmail.com.
